foraminal_input: Original frozen SpineNet 512-vector per automatically localized sagittal T2/STIR nine-plane ROI. NOT sagittal T1; no reference coordinates. Identical vector for two independent side heads.
subarticular_input: Sealed mixed-localizer v7 predicted 50mm axial T2 canal ROI; unchanged ResNet18; mean of up to three same-series centre/context bags. Concatenate global, anatomicalLEFT (map columns4:7) and anatomicalRIGHT (columns0:3) layer4 averages. Middle column excluded from side-specific pools; no claim of root segmentation.
head: Four independent 3-class level/side readouts; linear or shared64-ReLU-dropout0.2 plus12-output layer. No backbone updates.
normalization: Mean and std fitted only on assessed TRAIN vectors; standard deviation floor1e-5; standardized features clipped to [-10,10].
class_weights: Per-head inverse sqrt TRAIN known-grade frequencies, normalized to mean1.
selection: Best pooled fixed-three-class validation macro-F1 within each predeclared run; earliest epoch on ties. Both architectures and all seeds reported. No architecture selection claimed as independent improvement.
baseline: Majority TRAIN class independently for each level and side. Same image-assessment coverage, failure remains explicit.
evaluation: All requested levels/sides incl image failures and missing references. MacroF1 on known and assessed; severe recall denominator all known severe including failures; level-side breakdown. Mean-probability ensemble per architecture; no TEST.
interpretation: Development validation repeatedly used, including epoch selection. SagT2 for foramina is a restricted first experiment; cannot infer Lee0-3 or root compression. Existing central-stenosis model/site not replaced.
